title: Senior AppSec Engineer JD
text:
About us
Example Corp builds payments infrastructure used by millions of merchants.

Responsibilities
- Embed security into the CI/CD pipeline without slowing delivery
- Partner with engineering teams on secure design reviews
- Own the vulnerability management program

Requirements
- 5+ years in application or product security
- Hands-on experience with SAST, DAST and dependency scanning
- Strong communication with developers
